newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.

text.p: Mikuni and Co Ltd said on Friday it had assigned the following preliminary ratings to planned bond issues:
-AA-
The Kansai Electric Power Co Inc, $500 million mortgaged due 2005
Marui Co Ltd, 40 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2012
The Osaka Stadium Co Ltd, 50 million Swiss Francs unsecured with warrants due 2000, private placement, guaranteed by Sanwa Bank (AA)/ Sumitomo Trust & Banking (A)
Nihon Inter Electronics Corp, 40 million Swiss Francs unsecured with warrants due 2000, private placement guaranteed by Bank of Yokohama
Tokyo Radiator MFG Co Ltd, 18.5 million mark unsecured due 2001, private placement, guaranteed by Industrial Bank of Japan
-BBB-
Nippon Steel Corp, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2002
-BB-
Kawasaki Steel Corp, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2004
Chemiprokasei Kaisha Ltd, 25 million Swiss Francs unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement
NKK Corp, 15 billion yen unsecured due 2000
30 billion yen unsecured due 2001
20 billion yen unsecured due 2003
Sapporo Breweries Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2001
Sumitomo Realty & Development Co Ltd, 20 billion Euroyen unsecured due 2001, privae placement
Tomoku Co Ltd, five billion yen unsecured due 2000
five billion yen unsecured due 2002
-CC-
Isuzu Motors Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2000
10 billion yen unsecured due 2001
10 billion yen unsecured due 2002
Sumitomo Coal Mining Co Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement
